contexts.text: Into the shadow of my roof () = in the good of charity. A house, which is here called the shadow of the roof = good.
The shadow of the roof = in a general obscurity. Explained.

The beam which is in his eye () = huge falsity of evil; for wood, in the inward sense, = good; and in the opposite sense, evil. In the other life, good is represented by a beam, wherefore they who invent good for themselves are seen carrying a beam, and thus step along safely. AE 746:16.
By wood is signified good, and hence by a beam, the truth of good; and, in the opposite sense, the falsity of evil.
By a beam is signified the falsity of evil also in  and . . .
